_: The ONE register of estate memory. The audit reads this; nothing about memory is true unless a probe here says so. verdicts: KEEP (must reach 'operating'), HOLD (frozen, not adopted), RETIRE (code must be gone), DECIDE (founder). Refresh verified_at only by re-running the audit on a fresh clone of main, never by editing.

lanes.name: Memory door: remember / recall / brief over the one MCP door
lanes.why: ADR 0006. The interface every agent already has. Unreachable since 2026-10-29 (OKE control plane removed).

lanes.name: Unified memory server (Postgres, harness, ranking, consolidation)
lanes.why: The only store with guards, bi-temporal facts, ranking and a door. Needs a home (k3s or PAYG): founder decision.

lanes.name: Claude Code hooks: session brief, refuse unbriefed edit, refuse stop without write-back
lanes.why: The only enforcement; Claude Code only. Rule must move to lane-submit so it is harness-independent.

lanes.name: Pi and opencode session-start brief extensions
lanes.why: Injects a brief; no enforcement. Live probe: bin/estate-brief (which both extensions run) rewrites focus-register.json each time it reads the claim ledger. That proves a brief ran on this machine in the last day, not that pi or opencode ran it (the file is shared with the other runtimes); no per-runtime record exists yet.

lanes.name: Router Active Memory + Active Focus block on every model call
lanes.why: Founder 2026-10-20: all models and harnesses must use memory without per-runtime adapters. Dies with the router. Live probe: the launchd log bin/litellm-local writes, where active_memory.py logs 'injected' or 'skipped' per call. It proves the router is alive and logging, not that a block was injected (only mtime is read).

lanes.name: Router graph capture -> spool -> growmos drain
lanes.why: Agents are not asked; every exchange lands in the graph. Dies with the router.

lanes.name: growmos estate-graph (what agents actually write to)
lanes.why: The only memory that ran continuously 09-23 to 10-31. Lexical only, no vectors.

lanes.name: Session checkpoint on the issue
lanes.why: ADR 2026-09-07: continuity lives on the issue, not in a vendor file. NO live probe yet and none is invented: bin/estate-checkpoint writes only a GitHub issue comment and a hashed stamp in the OS temp dir (no fixed local path). Needs a probe that reads the issue comment; none of the existing probe types does. KEEP_WITHOUT_LIVE_PROBE stays red until then.

lanes.name: Capture + claim-brief at claim-open and lane-submit (router-independent)
lanes.why: NEW. The path every harness already must take, so memory no longer depends on the router or on a hook.

lanes.name: Cross-surface canary: a fact written on surface A is briefed on surface B
lanes.why: NEW. The proof the founder asked for before anything more is built.

lanes.name: This audit, run on a schedule, alerting on red
lanes.why: NEW. Recurring, machine-run; the answer to 'is memory in use' without anyone digging.

lanes.name: Cortex retrieval engine (ADR 0050)
lanes.why: Manifests exist; no Dockerfile and no vendored source, so it cannot be built. Frozen until the cross-surface canary is green and a replay benchmark shows it helps.

lanes.name: bin/memory-mcp, memory-a2m, memory-dream (deleted 2026-10-31; launched a .memory stack that was never there)
lanes.why: Deleted 2026-10-31: each execed into ../.memory/.venv, which does not exist. rg found no caller that executed them (every hit was the live estate-memory-mcp or a prose mention), so nothing was repointed. The absent probes keep the deletion honest.

lanes.name: curation_worker.py (deleted 2026-10-31)
lanes.why: Deleted 2026-10-31: never deployed (spec 2026-10-19); its UPDATE reset updated_at. No code imported or ran it; consolidation.py only named it in a comment, now reworded. The absent probe keeps the deletion honest.

lanes.name: otto/memory fast_recall, otto_facts, otto-memory-store Job
lanes.why: ADR 0050: deleted in favour of the door. Write-only on 2026-10-02.
lanes.blind_reason: lives in the otto repo/cluster; this checkout cannot see it

lanes.name: Hindsight API
lanes.why: Zero requests in 24h on 2026-10-02; ADR 0050 retires it.
lanes.blind_reason: a cluster namespace; cannot be checked from the repo

lanes.name: Nine memory plugins in the hermes-agent image
lanes.blind_reason: lives in the hermes-agent image build

lanes.name: claude-mem (2026-09-05 spec)
lanes.why: Spec says hosted-only; ADR 0050 supersedes it in part. No evidence it was ever installed.

summary: Memory is one plane with 18 registered lanes (see table). None is proven operating by a live probe today.
The memory door and store have been unreachable since 2026-10-29 (OKE control plane removed). No new home is chosen yet.
Only Claude Code has enforcement. Cline and Codex have no memory path. Cursor and Gemini have the MCP tool and nothing injects it.
What agents actually write to today: the growmos graph and the router capture spool.
Cortex is HOLD: manifests only, no Dockerfile or vendored source, so it cannot be built.
Machine capture at claim-open and lane-submit, the cross-surface canary and the scheduled audit are specified (ticket 42), not built.
Open: the founder ballot D1 to D11 (docs/specs/2026-10-31-memory-one-plane.md).
